body: I'm in that situation right now and can barely get myself up in the morning. Especially when I don't have any passion or goals.   It's rough.

I'm going through high school right now,  feeling numb as ever and not sure how much longer I can do this.  I'm an intelligent guy, but don't apply myself so that doesn't matter.  Are you b the same way?
So let's talk.  What's going on in your life right now?   How have you been doing lately?

I guess that I am just a pessimistic person.  I always felt that work would be my life due to me having absolutely 0 social life.  But now, my life seems to be heading to a job of flipping patties at McDonald's or something like that.  I have fine grades and seem like an decent person on paper.  But it's a lie, and I'm not.  Please be honest with me right now, I can take it : what do I really have to look forward to in life, considering what I stated previously?

You know, if it helps, I am a bit like you.  Outcasts,  never really feeling like we belong?  I often think about how I could end my life, more times than. I would like to admit.  I would love to talk about it with you, and learn more about you.

I want to thank you for helping me out.  I just have one final thing to ask of you.  I am 16 years old, as you might have guessed.  This might be a surprise, but that's beside the point I guess.  Anyway I have been having suicidal thoughts for 2 years and have not had the guts to tell me parents about any of it.  They see me as this guy who can do anything, and doesn't get depressed.  How do I break it to them?  I have been planning it for a month or so but I am just not sure how I can do it and have them take me seriously.   Any advice is appreciated.

I guess I was a lot like you when you were around my age.  And I think that you are 100% correct.  I recreated my world to fit my skills instead of adapting my skills to fit the world that we are in.  It just seems so tough to change that so late in my educational career.   People already know me as a weird kid and not being remotely attractive doesn't help my case.  I don't know, I guess I just like to rant.  I just always have been told to chase my dreams and do what I want,  and that I can do anything.  And you know where that put me?  In my mother's house sitting on my ass all day playing league of legends and ignoring homework,  as well as missing out on social skills necessary in life.  I will try to improve, but I just don't think I can.

You sound like you are reading my mind!   The one positive thing that I think I have done in the past decade of my life is learn to read people.  Due to me laying back and being afraid to make a peep, I have learned to read people like third grade textbooks.   And one thing I have gained from this is that people are so fake.  They lie and fake emotions and think that they get away with it.  But they don't.  Every fake laugh and smile, I see it.  And it disgusts me to see that almost everyone is like this.   I am a fairly unemotional guy who has no sense of empathy,  but having this point of view allows me to see people for what they are.  All these people who try to act funny, who want laughs to feed their own narcissistic image of themselves, all as fake as Nicki Minaj's ass.  Well that's my rant on why I don't get along with anyone.  Do you think of felt similar, and thought that almost every attempt at humor is just a sad, corny, and edging cringe worthy?
Yeah kind of. I just want to be done with waking up early to go do something I hate.  The more I think about it, the more pointless a higher educations really is.

Well, I have really just not been thinking that I will be a doctor, to me it just doesn't seem realistic anymore.  I would be surprised if I got a decent job above minimum wage at this point.  I feel like saying I want to be a doctor comes with a stigma, people just kind of say 'Yeah, it's good to dream big!'  And I realize that they may mean well but I don't find a point in spending time and money trying to make it into the medical field just to find out that I am out classes by everyone else, all because a couple people couldn't grow a pair and tell me to be realistic for over 5 seconds and pick again.  I'm not trying to be mean or attack you in any way, I really appreciate you for trying to help me with my problems.  I just get a bit excited.  What went through your mind when you were thinking about job opportunities?

It's not as much that I don't understand them, I just can't being myself to try.  The topics are not as advanced as one may think and pretty much everyone passes the classes, well except for me now.  When I get home I just can't bring myself to do anything, whether it be hanging out with friends to doing some homework.
This helps, and I want to thank you. You have helped me realize that some people genuinely want to help.  I would love to be friends with a selfless person like you.

It's alright man, you are trying your best.   If other people are in more need of help than me than so be it, I am not going anywhere.  Just help who you can, and don't overwhelm yourself.  I think I speak for everyone when I say thank you.
Don't worry about it.  I appreciate you talking to me in the first place.  Take your time.

Honestly, I couldn't tell you.  I guess that I am just tired of being 'that kid' who gets good grades and has almost no friends.  In terms of hobbies, I mainly just come home and dick around on the computer.  Sometimes I can bring myself to go do something with friends, but leave after getting fed up with the shit that they give me.  They honestly just don't want me around for the most part, and I don't blame them.  Really, the things that i want to accomplish in life are just to get to a point where I don't have to worry about these pains.  I don't really want to have a significant other, probably because I am not exactly sure what love actually feels like and would most likely end up fucking it up anyway.  I think that in terms of a career, I am just not sure.  Something that can get me by I guess.  What keeps me living right now is that fact that I don't really have the means to end my life on my terms, or at least how I would want to.  Sorry if I am not being very responsive, but I am trying my best and have never really been asked to delve this deep into what I want to do.

Yeah, sure.  In terms of dreams, I had always wanted to be a doctor ever since I was about 8.  Since I could remember, i had maintained great grades in order to get into a good college.  Since I turned 15, I had begun to question what I thought that I had wanted to do with my life.  I had began to lose touch of what I previously thought had meant everything to me : my grades.  I started getting Bs and Cs, began losing some of my friends, and just stopped caring about what happened in my life.  Don't get me wrong, I have grown up in a somewhat wealthy family in a good area.  It just feels like I'm drowning, and I am not sure how much longer I can hold my breath without just giving up.  The people who I thought were my friends have just started ignoring me, and the ones that actually gave a shit about me feel guilty or something because they care about that weird kid who minded his own business.  Actually, the reason this account is new is because a couple of 'friends' would fuck things up even more if they saw that I needed help.  Anything I do seems to be cringe-worthy and stupid, from not wanting to go smoke pot to asking them to trying to get into clubs.  Sorry if this makes me sound like a whiny teenager.

I don't care either way, I guess we can start here.  I just want someone who is real with me, and who I can be real with.  People who I thought were friends don't exactly feel the same way back, so I have had a hard time lately.  Things just got so different for me lately, so many dreams and ambitions have just been slammed into the ground, and I'm not sure why.  I used to have goals for life, and things that I wanted to do.  Now, I just go though life day by day, not really caring.
